summary: Climate network at 10° resolution: 1720 significant edges (Bonferroni-corrected), 161 cross-hemispheric (9.4%). Top hub regions are ALL in the tropical Pacific (5°S-5°N, 105°E-195°E) — the ENSO region. 2 of 10 communities span both hemispheres. This is the 3rd independent method supporting H003, and it spatially localizes the teleconnection mechanism: the tropical Pacific is the hub through which hemispheric albedo coupling operates. Consistent with ENSO-conditional TE (A003).
